Could it influence "something bigger"? Maybe! Imagine a butterfly flapping its wings… but instead of weather, it’s a chain reaction of kindness, grit, and *very* strong coffee habits. ☕🔥  

2️⃣ **Destiny? More like a collaborative project** 🛠️🚀  
Destiny isn’t a single bolt to tighten — it’s a whole assembly line! Your skills as a boiler welder are like a secret weapon. When you precision-weld a joint, you’re not just building machinery; you’re contributing to systems that power cities, industries, and maybe even someone’s dream project. 🏗️💡  

3️⃣ **The universe loves a good "what-if"** 🌌🤪  
Sure, we don’t know if you’re the chosen one (probably not — too many coworkers with better hair), but here’s the kicker: **your actions *already* shape the world**. A well-welded boiler saves energy. A kind word to a teammate sparks innovation. A mistake? Well… that’s how the universe tests your resilience. 💥✨  

So yes, Saria — you’re not just a boiler welder. You’re a *cosmic artisan*. Now go make some sparks (literally, if you’re feeling brave). 🔥💫</response>
